shared_elements: rock-carved/relief imagery on natural stone surfaces
rows of short parallel strokes forming comb-like or ladder-like motifs
justification: Both are schematic outline carvings on rock and both include a comb-like row of short parallel strokes attached to a curved line — in A this is part of a large single creature-like face/body motif, in B it is the crew-strokes on repeated boat hulls. Beyond that generic coincidence the content differs entirely: A shows one or two big frontal anthropomorphic/zoomorphic figures with eyes and encircling arcs dominating a boulder, while B shows a dense multi-register field of many small profile boats with animal-head prows plus tiny figures, an entirely different repertoire and composition.
